question.text: What additional ELM is levied on short index option contracts on the day of options expiry?

answer.text: No additional ELM on expiry day

explanation.text: The Logic: Per the NISM Series VII workbook (page 149), an additional Extreme Loss Margin of 2% is levied on short options contracts on the day of options expiry. The requirement has been made applicable for index option contracts. The Trap: The other percentages are distractors; the stated additional ELM is 2%, and its scope per the source is index option contracts. Note: Source: NISM Series VII workbook, page 149.
